indicators.name: Persentase penduduk miskin (P0)

source.publisher: Badan Pusat Statistik Provinsi Jawa Barat
source.title: Jumlah dan Persentase Penduduk Miskin Menurut Kabupaten/Kota di Provinsi Jawa Barat, 2022 dan 2023
source.referencePeriod: March 2023 Susenas; district table labels year only, corroborated by companion table 4.6.1
source.denominator: All residents; poor persons / total population × 100

indicators.definition: Basic-needs headcount rate: residents whose average monthly per-capita consumption expenditure is below applicable regional food and non-food poverty line. Not poverty gap, severity or raw number of poor persons. Definitions printed 160/PDF236; period printed306/PDF382.
indicators.comparability: Same March2023 Susenas concept, person denominator, percent unit and district geography across27. Regional poverty lines vary by design; do not impose one nominal cutoff.
limitations: Rounded survey estimates; table supplies no sampling errors.
Measures incidence, not depth, vulnerability, debt or wealth.
March snapshot, not annual average; no September2023 poverty calculation.
indicators.redundancy: Related to average expenditure and HDI living standards, but measures lower-tail deprivation. Distinct from labour-force unemployment; no merge warranted.

preliminaryRecommendation.reason: Direct deprivation outcome with27/27 official same-period rates; retain separately from TPT.

acquisitionNotes.method: Re-read original official PDF table text and every numeric cell using pdftotext -bbox coordinate windows. Kept row order and kabupaten/kota sections; localized cells preserved. Previous transcription not used as extraction input.

indicators.name: Tingkat Pengangguran Terbuka (TPT)

source.publisher: Badan Pusat Statistik Provinsi Jawa Barat
source.title: Tingkat Pengangguran Terbuka (TPT) dan Tingkat Partisipasi Angkatan Kerja (TPAK) Menurut Kabupaten/Kota di Provinsi Jawa Barat, 2021–2023
source.denominator: Unemployed aged15+ / labour force aged15+ × 100; not total working-age residents

indicators.definition: Open unemployment percentage of labour force. Labour force includes employed, temporarily absent employed, and unemployed aged15+. Unemployed categories include seeking work, preparing business, discouraged persons, and jobs not yet started. Definitions printed102–103/PDF178–179; table3.2.2 footnote printed123/PDF199.
indicators.comparability: Same August2023 Sakernas, SP2020 projection weights, age15+ labour-force denominator and percent across27; do not substitute February provincial TPT.
limitations: Low TPT does not ensure decent work: informal, unpaid, low-hours and low-pay work count as employed.
Excludes people outside labour force; interpret alongside TPAK.
Two-decimal survey estimates without row-level uncertainty.
indicators.redundancy: Labour exclusion differs from consumption poverty. Do not merge poverty and TPT. Shares labour-force system with TPAK but measures different margin.

preliminaryRecommendation.reason: Complete comparable labour-market exclusion rate; separate from poverty, interpreted with unscored TPAK.

acquisitionNotes.method: Re-read original official PDF table text and every numeric cell using pdftotext -bbox coordinate windows. Kept row order and kabupaten/kota sections; localized cells preserved. Previous transcription not used as extraction input.

coverage.geography: 18 kabupaten and 9 kota; province aggregate excluded

indicators.name: Gini Ratio pengeluaran penduduk

source.publisher: Badan Pusat Statistik Provinsi Jawa Barat
source.title: Gini Ratio Kabupaten/Kota di Provinsi Jawa Barat
source.table: Dynamic table variable951, source2, encoded idOTUxIzI=; year123
source.unit: dimensionless coefficient0–1; not percent or0–100 index
source.denominator: Expenditure distribution across resident population; Lorenz cumulative population and expenditure shares, not a rate denominator

indicators.definition: Expenditure-inequality Gini from Lorenz curve. Zero is equality, one maximum inequality. Original2023 inequality booklet printed8/PDF8 defines scale and rising inequality. Not income or wealth Gini.
indicators.comparability: All27 values from official variable951/year123/turvar0/turtahun0, same March2023 note, three-decimal coefficient precision. Province3200 excluded;0.425 not copied to districts.
limitations: Current table updated2025-12-17; metadata supplies no per-year revision log or explicit weighting/revision note. District values cannot be certified unchanged since first2023 release; use dated snapshot consistently.
Original2023 booklet confirms province0.425 and definition but has no all27 district table; cannot establish district revision history.
Low inequality can coexist with widespread poverty; Gini not living-standard level.
No standard errors; three decimals do not prove rank differences significant.
indicators.redundancy: Distributional spread differs from poverty headcount and average expenditure. Pair with poverty, not replacement. Not HDI component.

preliminaryRecommendation.reason: All27 official same-series2023 values verified; adds distinct equality outcome. Preserve snapshot and disclose unavailable revision log.

coverage.geography: 18 kabupaten and 9 kota; province aggregate excluded

indicators.name: Pengeluaran riil per kapita disesuaikan (komponen IPM)

source.publisher: Badan Pusat Statistik Provinsi Jawa Barat
source.title: Komponen Indeks Pembangunan Manusia Menurut Kabupaten/Kota di Provinsi Jawa Barat, 2022–2023; lanjutan
source.referencePeriod: 2023 IPM standard-of-living component; annual real adjusted measure based on Susenas
source.unit: thousand rupiah per person per year, real and purchasing-power adjusted
source.denominator: Per resident; consumption divided by household members, annualised and adjusted; not household total or percent

indicators.definition: Canonical expenditure candidate is annual real adjusted IPM per-capita expenditure. Yearbook: Pengeluaran Riil per Kapita (Ribu Rupiah/Orang/Tahun). Official methods booklet PDF10–11: annual Susenas expenditure made real at2012=100 then adjusted using Rao-method PPP and96 commodities (66food,30nonfood). Cell11.153 means11153 thousand rupiah/person/year, not11.153rupiah.
indicators.comparability: Same2023 annual IPM component, person denominator, thousand-rupiah unit and adjustment across27. Numeric2023 cells match dedicated IPM appendix PDF89. Never mix with nominal monthly table11.3.
limitations: PPP improves spatial comparability but uses standardised basket/index, not each household actual cost of living.
Mean consumption does not describe inequality, income, wealth, service quality or individual costs.
Not cash income. Monthly nominal expenditure×12 is not this real adjusted series.
Preserve publication vintage; mixed-edition HDI components are not automatically interchangeable.
indicators.redundancy: Direct HDI component: never score alongside full HDI. In the proposed HDI-free model, mean real consumption differs from poverty headcount and expenditure inequality. Pearson r with poverty is -0.717711, below the absolute 0.85 redundancy flag.

preliminaryRecommendation.reason: Recommend for the next HDI-free model only. All 27 official 2023 real, purchasing-power-adjusted annual observations are comparable, vary adequately, and add mean material living standards beyond poverty and inequality. Nominal monthly expenditure remains context. No production change.

source.title: Tingkat Pengangguran Terbuka (TPT) dan Tingkat Partisipasi Angkatan Kerja (TPAK) Menurut Kabupaten/Kota di Provinsi Jawa Barat, 2021–2023
source.denominator: Labour force aged15+ / all working-age residents aged15+ × 100

indicators.definition: Economically active residents, employed plus unemployed, per100 working-age residents. Not employment-to-population ratio or formal employment rate. Definition printed107/PDF183; working-age definition printed102/PDF178.
indicators.comparability: Same reference period, working-age denominator, weighting and unit across27; descriptive comparison valid without welfare ranking.
limitations: Higher participation can mean access to work or economic necessity; lower participation can reflect schooling, care, age structure or discouraged workers.
All-sex aggregate hides gender/age composition; no automatic good/bad direction.

indicators.redundancy: Context for TPT denominator and exclusion outside labour force. Not monotonic independent welfare benefit.

preliminaryRecommendation.reason: Complete records but structurally ambiguous welfare direction; interpret without scoring.
